verdict.rationale: Steel documents exporting agent-trace runs in open formats (markdown, JSON, or a ZIP of markdown plus screenshots) and has a Files API. Because Steel is open source with a pre-built Docker image, users have a documented self-host path when leaving the cloud. However, these exports are per-run, and no account-wide export of all user data is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (sessions, profiles, credentials, files) in open formats, migration/offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
